data.title: 间桐樱 · 卫宫家庭院
data.description: 【间桐樱 · 卫宫家庭院】阳光和煦的卫宫宅庭院里，樱提着绿色洒水壶细心地浇灌着墙角的花草，清澈的水雾在阳光下泛着微光。微风扬起她的校服裙摆，她转头冲你温柔浅笑——「只要看着这些小花一天天健康长大，就觉得这个世界的每一天都充满希望呢。」
data.action: 提着洒水壶浇花，裙摆轻扬
data.promptProse: Sakura directs a fine stream from her green watering can onto the Emiya garden flowers, one hand on the handle and the other beneath its body. She turns her face without changing the water's direction. Beige blazer, red bow and pleated skirt retain her school uniform beneath a moving hair ribbon. The medium view includes plants beside the garden wall; sunlight catches droplets and leaf edges, casting overlapping foliage shadows on the soil.
